remarks.message: Hips are sagging — brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line from shoulders to ankles.
Shallow rep — only reached ~108° at the elbow. Lower until your elbows bend to about 90°.
Good depth — elbows reaching a strong bottom position.

tips: Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Tuck your elbows to roughly 45° from your torso, not flared straight out.
Strengthen your core (planks, hollow holds) to stop the hips dropping.
